cpu.method: sampled /bin/ps -ax -o pid=,ppid=,pgid=,rss=,time= every 5ms; CPU is the sum of each observed process's peak cumulative TIME, not exact per-sample elapsed CPU; ps TIME has 10ms display resolution and processes that exit between samples contribute only their last observed TIME

descendantRss.method: sampled /bin/ps -ax -o pid=,ppid=,pgid=,rss=,time= every 5ms; maximum summed descendant rss, KiB converted to bytes (1024-byte units)

io.reason: macOS /bin/ps exposes process-tree CPU time and resident memory but no tested aggregate read/write byte counter; process IO stays null

limitations.reason: macOS /bin/ps exposes process-tree CPU time and resident memory but no tested aggregate read/write byte counter; process IO stays null

wall.method: std::time::Instant from spawn through process exit and full stdout/stderr drain; includes timeout kill/reap grace

reconstruction.executable: Pre-synced Python interpreter from engine.executable (no uv install).
reconstruction.inputs: Verify every input sha256 before executing a workload.
reconstruction.source: Restore the private archive exactly as executed and verify its file digests; dirty.patch is evidence, not a patch to re-apply.

toolchain.cachePolicy: Prepared once before any timed sample; the same staged files are warm-file-cache for every warmup and measured sample.

tools.name: baksmali
tools.provenance: executable sha256 verified against tools.lock.json pin

tools.name: morphe
tools.provenance: executable sha256 verified against tools.lock.json pin

settings.cacheEviction: none; measured samples are warm-file-cache after declared warmups
settings.environmentIsolation: Each sample runs with HOME, XDG_*, TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP, and PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX inside its own temp root; only a fixed safe allowlist of parent variables is inherited; credential-like manifest keys are rejected.
settings.outputNormalization: Morphe workloads only: replace the numeric value span at $.testCases[*].durationSeconds with null, from the end; every other stdout byte, including options.durationSeconds, order, Unicode escapes, nulls, counts, statuses, and errors, is preserved. Raw stdout/stderr hashes are retained separately.
settings.toolCachePreparation: Only workload-required tools are copied once from the explicitly configured private cache into an owned staging directory before any timed sample. Each sample HOME receives a link at the tools.py cache path (.cache/aidans-patches/apk-lab/tools); the source cache is never modified and nothing is downloaded or installed during the run.

source.warning: HEAD is not the executed source because the worktree was dirty; use worktreeDigest and the private source archive.
